the potato plants with decreased sucrose synthase activity have decreased stomatal conductances and increased water use efficiency (i.e. more water is conserved in the plants).

we can use the tools of molecular biology to alter guard cell metabolism and thereby alter stomatal behavior and water use efficiency.
